verdicts.reason: A: the RSVP CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill crammed into the bottom-left corner alongside the badges, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the details it should introduce, the URL line comes before the time/venue, and the alignment is mixed (left vs centred). There is also a big dead band between the phone and the pills. B: the same buried CTA pill and jumbled order ('Presents' last, URL above the time), plus ragged centre/left alignment in the text block. A placeholder image box also floats awkwardly beside the phone. B's text block and centred pill row are better grouped and balanced, so it edges out A.
